title: Site meeting introduces a dated visitor-access obligation

correspondence.subject: LHP-957 meeting follow-up: Visitor access register
correspondence.body: Following the site meeting for LHP-957, security needs an additional deliverable called Visitor access register. Please provide the register listing each visiting technician and their access window by 18 March 2027. This was not part of the previous deliverables list; it is needed before the weekend work can be booked. Thanks, Dalia
